n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

N = 505
C = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(N)]
f = [0] * N
g = [0] * N
ff = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
gg = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

def safe_add(x, y):
    x += y
    if x >= mod:
        x -= mod
    return x

for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod

f[0] = 1
g[0] = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f[i] = safe_add(f[i], (f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod) * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1) % mod)
        g[i] = safe_add(g[i], (g[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod) * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1) % mod)
        g[i] = safe_add(g[i], (g[i - j] * f[j - 1] % mod) * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1) % mod)
        s = 0
        for k in range(1, i + 1):
            s = safe_add(s, abs(k - j))
        g[i] = safe_add(g[i], (f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod) * C[i - 1][j - 1] * s % mod)

ff[0][0] = 1
gg[0][0] = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, i + 1):
        if j == i:
            ff[i][j] = f[i]
            gg[i][j] = g[i]
            continue
        ff[i][j] = ff[i - 1][j]
        gg[i][j] = gg[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            ff[i][j] = safe_add(ff[i][j], (ff[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k] % mod) * C[j][k])
            gg[i][j] = safe_add(gg[i][j], (ff[i - k - 1][j - k] * g[k] % mod) * C[j][k])
            gg[i][j] = safe_add(gg[i][j], (gg[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k] % mod) * C[j][k])

print(gg[n][m])
